record.description_evidence:
Discover a smarter way to study with Tassomai, the learning and revision app that’s helped 1000s of students get top grades in their GCSEs and other exams.

Tassomai is a quiz-based online learning program for students from the ages of 7 to 16. Using Tassomai regularly builds core subject knowledge and boosts confidence, ensuring students are prepared for exams like GCSEs, 11+, 13+ and SATs.

Tassomai covers up to 10 subjects, depending on the learner’s age. At KS4 the content is exam-board specific and quizzes are curriculum mapped to ensure all of the key material is covered. 

Tassomai’s algorithm identifies a learner’s strengths and weaknesses as they answer quizzes and tailors the content accordingly. As well as multiple choice quizzes Tassomai also includes short tutorial videos and links to recommended resources for some subjects. Mai, a built in, AI-powered tutor is available for help when students are stuck or need a mistake explained to them.

Tassomai is trusted by teachers and parents. The app is used by hundreds of schools in England and Wales and by private subscribing families.

**Note that the Tassomai app is free to download and it allows access to your Tassomai account if you are a student who gets Tassomai through your school or if you already have a private subscription. Parents and teachers with accounts can also log in via the app to see their child’s/students’ progress. New private subscribers can set up paid subscriptions via the Tassomai website or via the app.**

Subjects covered by Tassomai: 
- Maths
- English
- Science
- History
- Geography
- Computer Science
- Latin
- French
- German vocab
- Spanish vocab

Awards and accreditations:

3 x Education Resource Award winners
8 x Bett Award finalists and Home Learning award winner
#3 in Business Cloud’s EdTech50

- Member of the British Educational Suppliers Association
- Evaluated by the Association for Science Education

PracticeMentor AI is a personalised AI practice tutor designed to help students improve through extra exercises, open-answer marking, instant feedback, and targeted study guidance.

Instead of simply giving answers, PracticeMentor helps students practise, understand their mistakes, and build stronger skills step by step. Students can complete exercises across subjects such as Maths, English, Science, Chinese, Biology, Technology and more. The app marks their work, explains what can be improved, and prepares the next set of exercises based on their performance.

Whether a student needs more practice, wants to strengthen weak areas, or is preparing for school assessments, PracticeMentor provides a smarter and more personalised way to study.

Key features:

• Personalised AI-generated exercises
PracticeMentor creates practice questions based on the student’s level, subject, and learning needs.

• Open-answer marking
Students are not limited to multiple-choice questions. They can write answers, explanations, workings, short responses, and longer written answers for AI review.

• Instant feedback and evaluation
The app marks responses and gives clear feedback on accuracy, reasoning, structure, grammar, and areas for improvement.

• Weakness analysis
PracticeMentor identifies topics, question types, and skills that need more practice, helping students focus on what matters most.

• Tailored next exercises
Based on previous answers and performance, the app prepares suitable follow-up exercises to support continuous improvement.

• Multi-subject learning
Practise across a range of subjects including Maths, English, Science, Chinese, Biology, Technology and other school topics.

• Study progress tracking
Students can review their performance and see where they are improving over time.

• Built for real learning
PracticeMentor encourages students to think, write, explain, correct mistakes, and develop stronger understanding — not just memorise answers.

PracticeMentor AI is suitable for students who want extra practice outside school, parents who want better learning support for their children, and learners who need personalised feedback to improve more effectively.
